objective: Determine whether the existing persistent-store LLM-origin findings can supply a leakage-safe retrospective pilot of in-family/out-of-family novelty as an investigation-depth trigger.

inventory_scope.population: Every finding row with non-null source_lens in the digest-frozen store.
inventory_scope.audit_unit: Persisted finding record, with aggregate exact-location-plus-lens grouping reported only as a duplication diagnostic.
inventory_scope.identity_disclosure: No finding identifiers, paths, titles, snippets, scores, ranks, outcomes, or candidate hashes are emitted.

evidence_eligibility: The finding originated from an independently acquired public production or deployment repository, not a purpose-built fixture, benchmark, manufactured control, or protected pre/post holdout.
The exact repository snapshot and provenance are available and attributable.
The finding and any novelty assignment can be shown to precede the first human outcome.
No project-owner assessment, classifier label, answer key, advisory-selected location, or equivalent outcome signal was available to candidate selection.
The finding can enter an outcome-blind, deduplicated review packet without source or family leakage.
Its evaluation family is independent of other counted families; repeat runs or aliases of one fixture do not add families.

classification.evidence_eligible: May contribute to a retrospective held-out benefit evaluation after a separately frozen packet and review protocol.
classification.protocol_development_only: May be used only to test schemas, deterministic grouping, and evaluation plumbing; it cannot support a novelty-benefit claim.

automatic_exclusions: Purpose-built UAT or calibration fixtures and repeat materializations of them.
Protected pre-fix or post-fix holdouts and any cohort with an external answer key.
Known-answer CVE or benchmark fixtures selected around a disclosed vulnerability.
Any finding with a prior human assessment or classifier label for the proposed outcome.
Any source whose exact provenance cannot be established without inspecting candidate outcomes.
audit_decision: The existing cohort can supply the retrospective pilot only if at least one evidence-eligible identity survives. A positive count does not clear OPT-009 and does not authorize packet selection, review, labeling, training, threshold selection, or policy change.
bounded_actions: Open the store read-only and verify it remains byte-identical.
Count source_lens findings and assessment existence by frozen provenance category.
Verify recorded source materialization availability without opening source content.
Persist one aggregate audit artifact and one descriptive result.
excluded: Scoring, ranking, suppression, model training, tuning, or recalibration
